block-guide:
CORE/PULLQUOTE One short line pulled out of the text and shown large, with an optional source. It holds ONE paragraph of text and no inner blocks. A longer quotation (several paragraphs, lists): core/quote. MARKUP (checked in the editor) Exactly figure > blockquote > p (+ cite) on one line, with no block comments inside. A second

or a paragraph block inside does not belong to this block: the editor reports it invalid. No citation = no . OPTIONS Text alignment: style.typography.textAlign -> class has-text-align- right after the align class. Colours and border follow the general class rules; the theme already gives it a large font size, so fontSize is rarely needed. align: left|right|wide|full only (no center). CHECK Reopen the editor: no invalid-content notice; the front shows the line large and the source small.
